Proposition
[Limit properties of Perelman's construction] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0124 ↗ thm:chow-iii-perelman-sphere ↗ prop:chow-iii-normalized-family-ancient 1. ch19:19.36a\group Spherical Construction

Hamilton compactness produces a nonflat ancient limit on $S^n$; it is $\kappa $-noncollapsed at all scales, has nonnegative curvature operator, and retains rotational symmetry and reflection invariance.
